script.t: Attention, shoppers. Thank you for visiting Greenleaf Market.
Our seafood counter will be closing early today, at five o'clock, for equipment maintenance.
If you'd like fresh fish for tonight's dinner, please visit the counter before then.
Also, don't forget that this week only, all frozen vegetables are twenty percent off.
And customers who use our mobile app will receive an extra five percent off at checkout. Thank you for shopping with us.

questions.question: Where is the announcement being made?

explanation.why: 'Attention, shoppers'와 Greenleaf Market, 해산물 코너, 냉동 채소 할인으로 보아 슈퍼마켓 안내 방송이다.
traps: dinner는 손님이 집에서 먹을 저녁 이야기다.
생선을 '판매'하는 코너가 있을 뿐 양식장이 아니다.
equipment는 해산물 코너 장비 점검 이야기다.

questions.question: Why will the seafood counter close early?

explanation.why: 해산물 코너는 장비 점검(for equipment maintenance) 때문에 5시에 일찍 닫는다.

questions.question: How can customers receive an additional discount?
choices: By signing up for a newsletter

explanation.why: 모바일 앱을 쓰는 고객은 계산 시 5퍼센트를 추가로 할인받는다.
traps: 5시는 해산물 코너 마감 시간이다. 숫자 재활용 함정.

para.p: customers who use our mobile app

script.t: Hi, Ms. Duarte. This is Phil from Crestview Realty, returning your call about the office space on Elm Street.
You mentioned you'd like to move in by the first of next month. Well, the current tenant is leaving two weeks early, so that won't be a problem.
I know you were concerned about parking. The building has twenty reserved spaces for tenants.
That's not all. There's also a public garage across the street that offers monthly rates.
I've arranged a viewing for Wednesday at ten. If that doesn't suit you, please call me at 555-0172.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the message?
choices: To respond to an inquiry about office space
To confirm that a lease has been signed

explanation.why: Elm Street 사무실에 대한 전화에 회신(returning your call)하며 입주 시기, 주차, 둘러보기 일정을 안내한다.
traps: 아직 둘러보기 단계라 계약 체결 확인이 아니다.
주차장은 문의에 답하며 소개한 정보일 뿐 광고가 목적이 아니다.

para.p: returning your call about the office space
para.a: respond to an inquiry about office space

questions.question: Why does the speaker say, “That's not all”?
choices: To say the building has more than twenty spaces

explanation.why: 건물에 전용 주차 공간 20개가 있다고 말한 뒤 '그게 다가 아니다'라며 길 건너 공영 주차장을 추가로 소개한다.
traps: 건물 안 주차 공간이 20개보다 많다는 뜻이 아니다. 문장 뜻 그대로 해석하게 만드는 함정.
앞의 말을 정정하는 것이 아니라 정보를 덧붙인다.

questions.question: What has the speaker arranged?
choices: A meeting with the current tenant

explanation.why: 수요일 10시에 사무실 둘러보기(a viewing)를 잡아 두었다고 했다.
traps: 현 세입자는 일찍 나간다는 정보로만 나온다.

script.t: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the Halston Glass Factory tour. My name is Irene, and I'll be your guide today.
We'll start in the furnace room, where you'll see our artists shaping glass by hand. It gets very hot in there, so please stay behind the yellow line at all times.
After that, we'll visit the design studio, where our team creates new patterns for vases and lamps.
The tour ends in our gift shop, where you'll receive ten percent off with your tour ticket.
You're welcome to take photos everywhere except in the design studio. Now, let's get started.

questions.question: Who most likely is the speaker?

explanation.why: 공장 견학 환영 인사와 함께 'I'll be your guide today'라고 소개했다.
traps: 유리 작가들은 견학 중 보게 될 사람들이다.
선물 가게는 견학 마지막 장소일 뿐이다.

questions.question: What are listeners asked to do in the furnace room?
choices: Keep their hands in their pockets

explanation.why: 용광로실은 매우 뜨거우니 항상 노란 선 뒤에 있으라고 했다.

questions.question: Where are listeners NOT allowed to take pictures?

explanation.why: 디자인 스튜디오를 제외한 모든 곳에서 사진 촬영이 가능하다고 했다.
traps: 용광로실은 안전선 주의 장소이지 촬영 금지 장소가 아니다.
선물 가게는 할인 정보와 함께 나왔을 뿐이다.
로비는 언급되지 않았고 '디자인 스튜디오 외 모든 곳'에 해당한다.

script.t: This is Mike Sullivan with your morning traffic report.
Drivers heading downtown on Highway 9 should expect delays of about twenty minutes because of road repairs near the Fulton Bridge. Two of the three lanes are closed until noon.
If you can, take Route 4 instead. It's moving smoothly this morning.
Also, the city's free shuttle bus to Riverside Stadium will begin running tomorrow, ahead of Saturday's championship game.
Stay tuned for the weather forecast after this short break.

questions.question: What is causing delays on Highway 9?

explanation.why: Fulton Bridge 근처 도로 보수 공사(road repairs) 때문에 지연된다고 했다.

questions.question: What does the speaker recommend?

explanation.why: 가능하면 Route 4를 대신 이용하라(take Route 4 instead)고 권했다.
traps: 셔틀버스는 경기장행이며 내일부터 운행한다는 소식일 뿐이다.

questions.question: What will listeners hear after the break?

explanation.why: 'Stay tuned for the weather forecast after this short break'라고 했다.
traps: 경기 이야기는 셔틀버스 안내에서 나왔을 뿐이다.

script.t: Let's look at last quarter's sales figures.
As you can see, the East region had the strongest results again, thanks largely to the new distribution center there.
But today I want to focus on the region with the lowest sales. Starting next month, we'll be adding three sales representatives there and running a regional advertising campaign.
I'd like each of you to send me your ideas for the campaign by Friday.

questions.question: Look at the graphic. Which region will receive additional staff?

explanation.why: 판매 실적이 가장 낮은 지역에 영업 사원 3명을 추가한다고 했다. 표에서 가장 낮은 곳은 South(140만 달러)다.
traps: East는 가장 높은 지역으로 칭찬받았다. 담화에서 직접 들린 지역명 함정.

questions.question: According to the speaker, why did the East region perform well?
choices: A new distribution center opened there.

explanation.why: 'thanks largely to the new distribution center there'라고 이유를 밝혔다.
traps: 인력 추가는 판매가 가장 낮은 지역에 대한 계획이다.
광고 캠페인도 앞으로 판매가 낮은 지역에서 할 일이다.

questions.question: What are listeners asked to do by Friday?

explanation.why: 금요일까지 캠페인 아이디어를 보내 달라(send me your ideas)고 했다.
traps: 채용은 회사 계획이지 청자에게 시킨 일이 아니다.

script.t: Good evening, and thank you all for coming to the Westbrook Business Awards.
Our next award honors an entrepreneur who has made a lasting contribution to our community.
Ten years ago, Leila Haddad opened a small bicycle repair shop on Main Street. Today, Haddad Cycles has four stores and employs more than sixty people.
Ms. Haddad also started a program that teaches bicycle maintenance to local high school students, free of charge.
Please join me in welcoming this year's Business Leader of the Year, Leila Haddad.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the speech?

explanation.why: 시상식에서 올해의 비즈니스 리더 수상자를 소개하는 연설이다.
traps: 매장 수(four stores)는 성과 소개일 뿐 개점 행사가 아니다.

questions.question: What is mentioned about Haddad Cycles?
choices: It has grown to several locations.
It is moving to Main Street.

explanation.why: 작은 수리점에서 시작해 지금은 매장 네 곳과 직원 60명 이상이 있다고 했다.
traps: Main Street는 처음 가게를 연 곳이다.

questions.question: What does Ms. Haddad's program offer?

explanation.why: 지역 고등학생에게 자전거 정비를 무료로 가르치는 프로그램이다.

para.p: teaches bicycle maintenance to local high school students, free of charge

script.t: Before we open the warehouse this morning, I have an update.
Starting today, all incoming packages must be scanned at the receiving desk before they're moved to the shelves.
I know what you're thinking. It'll slow us down. But last month, we lost track of nearly fifty packages, and scanning will let us see exactly where every item is.
To make this easier, we've added two more scanners at the receiving desk. Jamal will show you how to use them right after this meeting.

questions.question: Where does the talk most likely take place?

explanation.why: 'Before we open the warehouse this morning'이라고 했고, 입고 상품 스캔과 선반 이야기가 이어진다.
traps: packages가 나오지만 우체국 직원 대상 이야기가 아니다.

questions.question: Why does the speaker say, “I know what you're thinking”?

explanation.why: 새 스캔 절차를 발표한 뒤 '무슨 생각하는지 안다, 느려질 거라고'라며 직원들이 가질 만한 우려를 먼저 인정하고 이유를 설명한다.
traps: Jamal은 시연할 사람으로 나오며 신입 소개가 아니다.

questions.question: What will happen right after the meeting?

explanation.why: 회의 직후 Jamal이 스캐너 사용법을 보여 줄 것이라고 했다.
traps: 오히려 창고 문을 열기 전 회의다.

para.p: Jamal will show you how to use them

script.t: Thank you for calling Lumen Internet. Please note that our office will be closed on Monday for a national holiday.
If you're calling because your Internet service is not working, we may already be aware of the issue. Please check the service status page on our Web site before speaking with a technician.
To speak with a technician now, please choose the appropriate option from the menu.
Calls may be recorded for training purposes.

questions.question: Look at the graphic. Which number should a caller press to speak with a technician?

explanation.why: 기술자와 통화하려면 메뉴에서 알맞은 번호를 고르라고 했다. 기술자 = Technical support이므로 2번이다.
traps: 4번 상담원(Operator)은 일반 안내라 기술자 연결이 아니다.

questions.question: Why will the office be closed on Monday?
choices: Because staff will be in training

explanation.why: 'closed on Monday for a national holiday'라고 했다.
traps: 정전은 언급되지 않았다. 인터넷 장애와 혼동시키는 함정.
training은 통화 녹음 목적(training purposes)에 나온 단어다.

questions.question: What are callers encouraged to do?

explanation.why: 기술자와 통화하기 전에 웹사이트의 서비스 상태 페이지를 확인하라고 했다.

para.p: check the service status page on our Web site

script.t: Welcome to today's workshop on writing effective business e-mails. I'm Grace Tan, and I've been teaching business communication for fifteen years.
In the first hour, we'll look at common mistakes, such as writing subject lines that are too vague.
Then, after a short coffee break, you'll practice rewriting some real e-mails that our company has received.
The handouts I'm passing around now include a checklist you can keep at your desk.
Let's begin by having everyone introduce themselves and say which department they're from.

questions.question: What is the workshop about?

explanation.why: 첫 문장에서 '효과적인 비즈니스 이메일 작성' 워크숍이라고 했다.

questions.question: What will listeners do after the break?

explanation.why: 커피 휴식 후 회사가 받은 실제 이메일을 고쳐 쓰는 연습을 한다고 했다.

questions.question: What will listeners do next?

explanation.why: 마지막에 '모두 자기소개와 소속 부서를 말하는 것으로 시작하자'고 했다.
traps: 커피 휴식은 첫 한 시간 이후다.
체크리스트는 책상에 두고 쓰라고 했을 뿐 읽으라는 말은 없다.

script.t: Hello, everyone. I have some news about our office relocation.
The new building on Harbor Road is finally ready, and we'll be moving in two weeks.
Believe it or not, it's even closer to the subway station than our current office.
Each department will receive packing materials on Monday. Please label all boxes with your name and department.
The IT team will move the computers over the weekend, so you won't have to worry about those. If you have any questions, please contact Olivia Grant in Facilities.

questions.question: What is the main topic of the announcement?

explanation.why: 첫 문장에서 사무실 이전(office relocation) 소식을 전한다고 했다.
traps: 지하철역은 새 건물의 위치 장점으로 나온다.

questions.question: What does the speaker imply when he says, “Believe it or not, it's even closer to the subway station”?
choices: The new location is surprisingly convenient.
He is not sure where the building is.
The subway station will close soon.

explanation.why: '믿기 어렵겠지만 지하철역에서 더 가깝다'는 말은 새 위치가 생각보다 편리하다는 뜻이다.
traps: 운전하라는 뜻이 아니다. 오히려 지하철이 더 가깝다.

questions.question: What will the IT team do?

explanation.why: IT팀이 주말에 컴퓨터를 옮길 것이라고 했다.
traps: 포장 자재는 부서별로 '받는' 것이고 IT팀이 준다는 말은 없다.
상자에 이름을 붙이는 것은 직원들의 일이다.
문의는 시설팀의 Olivia Grant에게 하라고 했다.
